**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant on Northwind. Beyond mere silence, §12.3 affirmatively preserves our hiring freedom — including the right to hire "any person who responds to general recruitment" — and has Brightline acknowledge that Customer "has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment." This lands squarely on the playbook's preferred position, so there is nothing to narrow on duration, scope, or carve-outs.

One adjacent point noted but not flagged: §12.4 restricts Vendor from developing or marketing a service competing with Customer's proprietary analytics products during the term. That runs in our favour and falls outside this rule.
